## Summary

Yaqwb Naqeb is a Frontend Developer based in Iraq / Kurdistan who ships production web applications with React, Next.js, and React Router. He graduated with a B.Sc. in Software Engineering from the University of Koya and has since built the frontend for multiple live, in-market products spanning e-commerce, travel, and business-communication platforms.
